title: IdentityUseraddParams
description: Create one account in the launcher-managed Keycloak realm for a specific local knowledge base.

email.description: The email address that will sign in to this knowledge base.

password.description: The user's password. Secret: carried only in this local control request, never in progress, diagnostics, or persistent state.

generatePassword.description: Generate a random password in the launcher and return it once in the result.
